propositions: A DC-created issue must appear in the local store after an inbound pass, and a local edit must appear on the DC issue after an outbound pass, both proven live against a real store copy with zero unhandled exceptions.
The working repository used for testing must have no git remotes and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off to prevent unintended writes to production Jira or the tickets branch.

The scrubbed store copy must contain zero .bridge_state* artifacts (bindings and snapshots) to prevent reconciliation from forming intents to write to production issue keys, verified by enumerated artifact discovery not hardcoded lists.

Every inbound and outbound mutation (create, edit fields, transition, link, assign, delete) must round-trip and be asserted individually against a named oracle, with idempotence verified as a separate cell per mutation.

Multi-page pagination must be verified by observing the server's effective page size, seeding at least 2*observed+1 issues to force three pages, and asserting full recovery of seeded keys independent of local store content.
